title: Listening Drill — Cafeteria queue study
description: Student and tutor dialogue. One recording, four questions. Synthetic audio.

sections.title: Cafeteria queue study
sections.transcript:
STUDENT: I've started the project on waiting times in the cafeteria. I was going to use a questionnaire, but testing it with one person made me realise that the questions were too broad.

TUTOR: In that case, try observation first. But watch out for lunch rush. That can affect what you notice and what you end up writing down.

STUDENT: Would it help if I kept a daily log? I don't want to discover the problem only after I've handed everything in.

TUTOR: A better safeguard here is fixed intervals. Bring the timetable to our next meeting, so we can compare busy and quiet periods. There is no need to prepare the final presentation yet.
